text:
Priya_Sales: Heads-up: AlpineBank wants a short BYO-HSM POC. Key requirements: customer-owned KEKs in CloudHSM, quarterly rotation (they prefer 90d), dual-custodian approval for any rotation, and separate line-item for HSM run hours. Also asked for a test plan to prove we never see plaintext. @Sam_SE @Marta_Crypto

Sam_SE: We can do envelope encryption + CloudHSM-managed KEK. Two things to confirm: 1) do they require offline ceremony for KEK creation? 2) do they want us to support rotation rollbacks? If no rollbacks, we need explicit SOW language.

Marta_Crypto: Recommended approach: customer generates KEK in their CloudHSM, we perform Envelope-DEK generation inside our service but wrapped by their KEK (we never unwrap). For rotation, we trigger new DEK wraps and rotate references. Dual-custodian means rotation API calls must be authorized by two CloudHSM admin principals. That can be enforced via their IAM/policy config.

Priya_Sales: They want automated rotation but must have approvals required before we switch production keys. Also asked whether Redwood stores any key metadata.

Marta_Crypto: We store only key identifiers and rotation timestamps (logging), never KEK material or plaintext. We can add a metadata-only audit entry schema to the SOW.

Kyle_Network: Network note: if they use CloudHSM in aws-us-west-2, we need outbound to specific AZ endpoints and PrivateLink setup for Dedicated. Expect an extra ~3-10ms. I'll draft the minimal security group egress rules.

Priya_Sales: Billing question: will HSM hours be passthrough? Customer expects us to bill separately to avoid surprises.

Sam_SE: Standard practice: include HSM provider charges as passthrough. For POC, propose Redwood covers first X hours (e.g., 100h) and then passthrough thereafter, or present two options in the quote.

Alex_Customer (external): We prefer Redwood to not absorb costs beyond a small trial. Pass-through is fine. Also need an acceptance test to prove no plaintext leakage during decryption.

Marta_Crypto: I'll supply a small acceptance test harness: generate test payloads, encrypt with DEK, attempt decrypt only via wrapped flow, and present logs showing we only operate on wrapped keys. Harness estimate: 2-3 hours to configure + 1h test run. I'll attach sample commands.

Sam_SE: Sample SSQ answer snippet for "key custody":

```
key_custody: customer_managed
keystore_location: customer_cloudhsm
access_controls: zero-plaintext-access enforced
logging: rotation_id, timestamp, operator_id (no key material)
```

Tess_Legal: Contract asks: include explicit clause "Customer retains exclusive ownership of KEKs. Redwood will have no access to KEK material." Also add a "Dual-Custodian Approval" appendix describing the approval flow and responsibilities. We'll need to include risk acceptance if customer forbids rollback.

Priya_Sales: Ops estimate for SOW: can we get rough hours for automated vs manual rotation? Client expects rotation included in POC budget.

Marta_Crypto: Estimates: automated integration for POC: 6h (integration + tests). Ongoing maintenance: ~1h per rotation for monitoring and verification. Manual ceremonies: 8h per ceremony (coordination + ops) plus travel if on-site. Recommend automation.

Kyle_Network: I'll add PrivateLink runbook to ticket POC-5588 and paste specific CIDRs (us-west-2 CloudHSM endpoints + our egress).

InfraBot: POC-5588 created: "AlpineBank BYO-HSM POC"  Assignee: Sam_SE  https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/POC-5588

Tess_Legal: Also ensure we add a fallback rollback plan to the SOW: if rotation causes service degradation, who initiates rollback and how is liability allocated. If they disallow rollback, we need an explicit sign-off.

Alex_Customer: We will disable rollback in production but can allow a recovery window during POC. We'll provide CloudHSM admin IAM principals for the POC only.

Priya_Sales: Action list: Sam - populate SSQ crypto & attach sample config; Marta - add SOW rotation appendix and effort estimates; Kyle - paste CIDRs & PrivateLink steps in POC-5588; Tess - draft dual-custodian/legal appendix and rollback language. Target: SOW draft by 2026-04-01, POC kickoff week of 2026-04-18.

Sam_SE: Sending initial SSQ answers and sample config to POC-5588 now.

Kyle_Network: CIDRs posted to POC-5588. Added PrivateLink SG example and note about MTU for HSM connections.

Marta_Crypto: Uploaded test harness README and run commands to POC-5588. Will demo during kickoff.

Priya_Sales: Thanks everyone. Alex, will follow up with a short one-pager summarizing the options and a quote with both passthrough and Redwood-trial options.

Alex_Customer: Thanks all. Looking forward to kickoff.
